rationale: The closest supported optimization is dependency caching (P-LIT-GHA-CACHE), but its preconditions are not met for this workflow. The Ruby gems and apt packages are installed unpinned (`sudo gem install asciidoctor asciidoctor-pdf` and `sudo apt-get install -y make ruby`) with no Gemfile.lock or equivalent dependency manifest present in the repository, so there is no stable lockfile/environment input to key the cache on. Caching unpinned, mutable dependencies without invalidation risks serving stale dependency versions and is listed as a contraindication (mutable or untrusted cached content). Other candidate patterns are not applicable or are contraindicated: P-LIT-CANCEL-STALE conflicts with the release/deployment jobs in this workflow; P-LIT-FAIL-FAST requires a matrix (none exists); test selection/prioritization patterns require a test suite (this workflow builds documentation, not tests). No supported change preserves the intended build coverage safely, so the workflow is left unchanged.
